note: Chosen on development seasons only (alt_models.md). Each rule is run ONCE on its holdout. Pass = one-sided p < 0.0167 (3 rules, Bonferroni) AND the stated profitability bar. Features: walk-forward opponent-adjusted ratings of points, PPA, success rate, explosiveness, plays, rush/pass PPA, line yards, stuff rate, power success, second-level/open-field yards, standard/passing-downs PPA; plus margin ridge, CFBD pregame Elo, talent and returning production, week, home field. FBS vs FBS only. Prices are not in the CFBD data, so -110 is assumed (break-even 52.38%).

R1_opener_spread.model: all_linear (OLS with ridge 1.0 on every feature) predicting the home margin, fit on 2014-2023 results
R1_opener_spread.bet: side the model favors vs the OPENING spread (CFBD spreadOpen, median of providers) when |model - open| >= 5
tests: cover rate vs the opening number > 52.38% with one-sided p < 0.0167
mean line move toward our side (close - open) > 0

R2_close_residual.model: LightGBM (300 trees, lr 0.02, 7 leaves, min 80) predicting result minus closing spread from every feature + the close, fit 2014-2021
R2_close_residual.bet: side of the predicted residual when |predicted residual| >= the 80th percentile of |predicted residual| on 2019-21 validation (threshold frozen from the dev fit)
tests: cover rate vs the close > 52.38% with one-sided p < 0.0167

R3_close_totals.model: OLS total from sums of adjusted points, plays, PPA, success rate and explosiveness, fit 2014-2021
R3_close_totals.bet: over/under vs the closing total when |pred - close| >= 3
tests: hit rate vs the close > 52.38% with one-sided p < 0.0167
